activeSlice.scope: Align Hunter V1 shadow comparability with the production Hunter degradation contract: reject discovery or judgment/model degradation, but allow individual enrichment-fetch fallback that production explicitly tolerates by retaining discovery evidence. Preserve measured evidence/model work, positive control cost, all rollout thresholds, and Hunter V1 production authority.
successCriteria: A V1 control is rejected when discovery degrades or Hunter judgment/model execution degrades.
A V1 control remains comparable when only individual enrichment fetches fail and production Hunter falls back to the original discovery evidence.
Comparable V1 controls still require non-zero evidence, at least one measured model invocation, and positive measured cost.
Valid zero-recommendation V1 judgments remain comparable when substantive control work completed.
No rollout threshold changes: latency 1.5x, cost 1.5x, retrieval 0.85, failure 0.05, exploration 0.08-0.20, maximum topic share 0.34.
Three distinct Brands and nine paired observations remain mandatory for the pre-gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: V1 controls completed real retrieval/model work (20→3 and 19→6/3) with measured Agent Reach searches, but comparability rejected production-tolerated enrichment fallback because the shadow guard treated every enrichment diagnostic as critical degradation.
